subject: Finley Golf Club and a Curtis Media audience
body:
Hi Erica,

Curtis Media sells reach to local advertisers for a living, which makes this an unusual email to write. Finley is one of the few places offering a Triangle audience that cannot be bought as a spot.

Finley Golf Club is Carolina's home course. Rather than fixed sponsorship tiers, we build programs around what makes the most sense for each business, and with a media company it tends to run in both directions.

That could mean Curtis Media brands present at tournaments and member events, a day at the club for sales teams or their largest accounts, or something built jointly and sold on to advertisers.

Would 15 minutes be worth it? Tuesday or Thursday are both open on my end.

Best,

subject: Finley Golf Club — an idea for Curtis Media
body:
Hi Cassandra,

Marketing inside a radio group means you spend most of your time making other people's brands look good, which is why I wanted to put this in front of you rather than a sales manager.

Finley Golf Club is Carolina's home course, in Chapel Hill. Rather than fixed sponsorship tiers, we build programs around what makes the most sense for each business.

For Curtis Media that could mean station presence at club events, a day at the course for advertisers you want to keep, or a joint promotion neither of us could run on our own.

You would know better than I would where something like this sits internally. If it belongs with someone else, would you mind pointing me their way?

Best,

subject: Finley Golf Club and Pendomonium week
body:
Hi Gracie,

Pendomonium lands in Raleigh again next May, and the part of that week I'd guess is hardest to solve isn't the main stage. It's what you put in front of the customers who flew in and expect more from the trip than a session block.

Finley Golf Club is Carolina's home course, about half an hour from downtown. Rather than fixed sponsorship tiers, we build programs around what makes the most sense for each business.

For Pendo that might be a customer outing the day before the festival opens, a smaller executive round for the accounts you most want in the room, or the club as a venue for a team day once the conference is over.

Any chance you've got 15 minutes? Tuesday or Thursday both work on my end.

Best,

subject: Finley Golf Club and Pendo's Raleigh footprint
body:
Hi Laura,

Putting a nineteen-story headquarters on Hillsborough Street was a fairly public statement about where Pendo belongs, and communications is where a commitment like that either keeps showing up or quietly stops.

I lead corporate partnerships at Finley Golf Club, Carolina's home course in Chapel Hill. Rather than fixed sponsorship tiers, we build programs around what makes sense for each company.

What that could look like for Pendo: the company's name attached to something in the Triangle that isn't a tech event, somewhere to bring press and local partners that isn't an office tour, or a standing day out for the team.

If partnerships sit with someone else on your side, even a quick pointer would help. Otherwise, would 15 minutes be worth it?

Best,

subject: Finley Golf Club — an offline idea for Pendo
body:
Hi Mackenzie,

Running digital for a product-led company means nearly everything you buy reports on itself, and the things that don't tend to be first out when budgets tighten. That's most of why I wanted to make this concrete rather than vague.

Finley Golf Club is Carolina's home course, here in Chapel Hill. Rather than fixed sponsorship tiers, we build programs around what makes the most sense for each business.

For Pendo that could mean brand presence somewhere your buyers actually spend a Saturday, rounds the sales team can use with accounts that have gone quiet, or an outing built around a launch instead of another webinar.

Would a quick 15 minutes work? I'm around Tuesday or Thursday.

Best,

subject: Finley Golf Club and CData's Chapel Hill office
body:
Hi Shawn,

Marketing operations usually ends up being the function asked to justify the spend that doesn't come with a dashboard, so I'll put the specifics up front. Finley Golf Club is Carolina's home course, and your building on Europa Drive is about five minutes from our first tee.

Rather than fixed sponsorship tiers, we build programs around what makes the most sense for each business, so this would be sized to what CData actually uses.

That might be branded presence at member and tournament play, rounds the team can draw on with partners through the year, or the club as the venue for a company event you'd otherwise book at a hotel.

Worth 15 minutes to walk through the numbers? Tuesday or Thursday are open.

Best,

subject: Finley Golf Club and CData's embedded partners
body:
Hi Craig,

Embedded and OEM deals don't close in a demo. They close after a long stretch of a partner deciding they trust the people behind the product, and there are not many settings that move that along faster than a few hours outdoors.

I run corporate partnerships at Finley Golf Club in Chapel Hill, a short drive from Europa Drive. We've moved away from fixed sponsorship tiers and now build programs around what each business actually needs.

For your side that could mean rounds kept on hand for partner executives visiting the office, a hosted day timed to a renewal, or the course as neutral ground for a conversation that has stalled over email.

Any chance you've got 15 minutes this week or next?

Best,

body:

Running marketing projects means you're the one who has to find the venue, and in the Triangle the honest options for a company day come down to a hotel ballroom, a brewery, or somewhere that costs everyone an hour of driving.

Finley Golf Club is Carolina's home course, in Chapel Hill. Rather than fixed sponsorship tiers, we build programs around what makes the most sense for each business.

Best,
